# Tack, tack!

> Tack, tack! (tacktackstudio.com) is an independent shop in Hong Kong for curated design classics from around the world: furniture, lighting and objects, new and pre-loved. Every price is shown on the site in Hong Kong dollars. Enquiries and sales happen over WhatsApp; pickup is by appointment, with delivery anywhere in Hong Kong. The site is in English and Traditional Chinese (/zh/).

## Facts
- Who we are: Tack, tack! is an independent shop in Hong Kong for curated design classics from around the world: furniture, lighting and objects, new and pre-loved.
- What's listed now: Pieces from Isamu Noguchi AKARI, DULTON and Heller (Anna Dawson), all brand new. Every price is shown on the site in Hong Kong dollars.
- How to buy: Message us on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. There's no online checkout: we confirm availability, send extra photos if you like, and share payment details.
- Payment: FPS, PayMe, bank transfer or cash, and PayPal for overseas buyers.
- Pickup & delivery: Pickup is by appointment (we share the address when you book), or we deliver anywhere in Hong Kong, quoted before you pay.
- Holds: Under HK$1,500 we take full payment. From HK$1,500 to HK$9,999, a 30% deposit holds a piece for up to 7 days; from HK$10,000, a 20% deposit (min. HK$3,000) holds it for up to 14 days.
- New pieces: Every Thursday. Follow @tacktackstudio on Instagram or Threads.
- Contact: WhatsApp +852 6507 0791 (https://wa.me/85265070791), email hello@tacktackstudio.com, Instagram and Threads @tacktackstudio
- Returns: all sales are final; if a piece is materially different from its description when you view it, the deposit is refunded in full.

## Brands
- [Isamu Noguchi AKARI](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/isamu-noguchi-akari/): AKARI is the series of paper light sculptures Isamu Noguchi began in 1951, after visiting Gifu, a Japanese town known for its paper lanterns. Every shade is washi paper stretched over bamboo ribbing, and each one is still made by hand by Ozeki & Co. in Gifu. Every listing here carries an honest condition grade and real measurements. The shades are sold without the cord set: a cord add-on or installation is available, and we quote it on WhatsApp.
- [DULTON](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/dulton/): DULTON is a Japanese homeware brand known for taking everyday, utilitarian objects and making them more fun to live with. Its Double Face Clock borrows from the two-sided clocks hung in train stations and public buildings, redrawn as a long, low rectangle that suits homes with lower ceilings. Our DULTON clocks are shipped from Japan, and they're rental-friendly: hang one on a removable adhesive hook or stand it on a shelf, no drilling needed.
- [Heller](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/heller/): Heller is the American design brand behind Swell, the wave-shaped wall catchall by designer and California surfer Anna Dawson. Heller spotted her prototype at WantedDesign in 2022 and launched it at ICFF in 2023, in collaboration with MoMA; the smaller Swell Mini followed in 2025. Both hang on the wall and hold everyday things, from coats and bags to keys and glasses, which makes them a practical fit for a Hong Kong entryway.

## Questions and answers

### Where can I buy Noguchi AKARI lamps in Hong Kong?
At Tack, tack!, an independent design shop in Hong Kong. We currently list the AKARI 30A (Ø30 cm, HK$1,680), 45D (45 cm, HK$1,780) and 55D (55 cm, HK$2,080), all brand new. To buy, message us on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. Pickup is by appointment, or we deliver anywhere in Hong Kong.

### Which AKARI size should I choose?
Start with the room. The 55D (55 cm) suits a living room or the space above a dining table; the 45D (45 cm) suits a bedroom or a smaller living room; the 30A (Ø30 cm) suits a hallway, reading corner or small bedroom. The size guide on this page draws the shades to scale, and we're happy to send real photos and measurements on WhatsApp.

### Is the cord included with AKARI lamps?
No. Our AKARI shades are sold without the cord set. A cord add-on or installation service is available: WhatsApp us for a quote.

### Where can I buy the DULTON Double Face Clock in Hong Kong?
At Tack, tack!, an independent design shop in Hong Kong. We currently list Double Face Clock Rectangle (W 44.2 × D 9.8 × H 18.7 cm, HK$1,328) in Grey and Green, all brand new. To buy, message us on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. Pickup is by appointment, or we deliver anywhere in Hong Kong.

### Does the DULTON Double Face Clock tick?
No. It has a sweep movement, so there's no ticking. The dial is held by magnets for easy time-setting and battery changes, and it runs on 2 × AA batteries.

### Is the DULTON clock shipped from Japan, and do I need to drill?
Yes, it's shipped from Japan. Rental-friendly: hang it on a removable adhesive hook or stand it on a shelf, no drilling needed.

### Where can I buy Heller Swell in Hong Kong?
At Tack, tack!, an independent design shop in Hong Kong. We currently list Swell (W 73 × D 7.6 × H 35.6 cm, HK$980) in White, Red Orange and Blue; Swell Mini (W 19.7 × D 7.6 × H 16.5 cm, HK$280) in Red Orange, Cream and Blue, all brand new. To buy, message us on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. Pickup is by appointment, or we deliver anywhere in Hong Kong.

### What's the difference between Swell and Swell Mini?
Size and use. Swell has three waves: the crests catch coats, bags and caps, and the troughs hold keys and sunglasses. Swell Mini is a single wave, part hook and part catchall bowl, for a tote by the door or glasses by the bed. Sizes: Swell (W 73 × D 7.6 × H 35.6 cm, HK$980) in White, Red Orange and Blue; Swell Mini (W 19.7 × D 7.6 × H 16.5 cm, HK$280) in Red Orange, Cream and Blue.

### Where is Tack, tack! based?
In Hong Kong. We sell online and over WhatsApp rather than from a shop floor: pickup is by appointment and we share the address when you book, or we deliver anywhere in Hong Kong.

### Are your pieces new or second-hand?
Both. We sell curated design classics from around the world, new and pre-loved, and every listing shows its condition grade, from Brand new to Fair.

### How do I buy something?
Tap the WhatsApp button on the piece you like. We'll confirm availability, send extra photos if you'd like, and share payment details. Once your payment or deposit arrives, it's yours.

### Can you hold a piece for me?
Yes, with a deposit. Under HK$1,500 we take full payment; HK$1,500–9,999 needs a 30% deposit (held up to 7 days); HK$10,000+ needs 20% (min. HK$3,000, up to 14 days). Messages and likes don't hold items.

### Which payment methods do you accept?
FPS, PayMe, bank transfer and cash, plus PayPal (for overseas buyers). We don't take card payments on the site, and there's no checkout on the site.

### What do the condition grades mean?
We use five steps: Brand new, Near mint, Excellent, Good and Fair. Each listing adds notes on any marks, wear or missing parts. Ask and we'll send close-ups.

### Can I see a piece before buying?
Yes. Viewings are free and by appointment (about 30 minutes). A viewing doesn't hold the item, so place a deposit if you don't want to miss it.

### Do you deliver?
Yes, anywhere in Hong Kong. Small pieces can go by courier; large furniture goes by movers. We quote before you pay.

### Do you offer installation?
Yes. Installation service available. Ask us for details.

### Where do I pick up?
Pickup is by appointment. We'll agree a time on WhatsApp and share the address when you book.

### Will lamps work in Hong Kong?
Hong Kong runs on 220V with UK-style plugs. For every lamp we'll tell you exactly which cord set, fitting and bulb are included, and whether you need an adaptor or an electrician. Just ask before you buy.

### Do lamps come with a cord?
Each listing says so. Our Isamu Noguchi AKARI shades are sold without the cord set: a cord add-on or installation is available, and we quote it on WhatsApp. More AKARI questions are answered on the AKARI page .

### Can I return an item?
All sales are final, which is why we're generous with photos, measurements and answers before you buy. If a piece is materially different from its description when you view it, we refund your deposit in full. This doesn't affect your rights under Hong Kong law.

### Why did a piece sell while I was asking?
We sell through the website, Instagram, Threads and WhatsApp at the same time, and the first paid order wins. If something sells before we confirm your order, we refund you in full within 2 working days.

### When do new pieces arrive?
Every Thursday (Fresh Thursday). Follow @tacktackstudio on Instagram or Threads for first looks.

- 點樣購買：WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）或電郵 hello@tacktackstudio.com。網站不設網上付款：我們會確認存貨、按需要提供更多相片，並提供付款資料。
- 付款方式：FPS 轉數快、PayMe、銀行轉帳或現金，海外買家可用 PayPal。
- 自取及送貨：預約自取（確認後提供地址），或全港送貨，運費於付款前報價。
- 留貨：HK$1,500 以下須全數付款；HK$1,500–9,999 付 30% 訂金可留貨最多 7 天；HK$10,000 或以上付 20% 訂金（最少 HK$3,000）可留貨最多 14 天。
- 上新：逢星期四上新。追蹤 Instagram 或 Threads @tacktackstudio。

### 香港邊度可以買到野口勇 AKARI 紙燈？
Tack, tack! 是香港的獨立設計小店，現有 AKARI 30A（Ø30 cm，HK$1,680）、45D（45 cm，HK$1,780）及 55D（55 cm，HK$2,080），全部全新。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）或電郵 hello@tacktackstudio.com 即可查詢購買；可預約自取，或全港送貨。

### AKARI 應該揀邊個尺寸？
先諗清楚擺喺邊個房間。55D（55 cm）適合客廳或餐桌上方；45D（45 cm）適合睡房或較小的客廳；30A（Ø30 cm）適合走廊、閱讀角或小睡房。本頁的尺寸指南按實際比例繪畫，亦歡迎 WhatsApp 索取實物相片及尺寸。

### AKARI 有冇包電線？
沒有。我們的 AKARI 燈罩不包電線。可加購電線或安排安裝服務，歡迎 WhatsApp 查詢報價。

### 香港邊度可以買到 DULTON 雙面掛鐘？
Tack, tack! 是香港的獨立設計小店，現有 Double Face Clock Rectangle（W 44.2 × D 9.8 × H 18.7 cm，HK$1,328），有灰色及綠色，全部全新。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）或電郵 hello@tacktackstudio.com 即可查詢購買；可預約自取，或全港送貨。

### DULTON 雙面掛鐘會唔會有滴答聲？
不會。它使用掃秒機芯，冇滴答聲。鐘面以磁石固定，調時間及換電池都方便，使用 2 粒 AA 電池。

### DULTON 掛鐘係咪日本直送？要唔要鑽牆？
係，日本直送。租屋友善：可用免釘黏貼掛鉤，或直接放在層架上，無需鑽牆。

### 香港邊度可以買到 Heller Swell？
Tack, tack! 是香港的獨立設計小店，現有 Swell（W 73 × D 7.6 × H 35.6 cm，HK$980），有白色、橙紅色及藍色；Swell Mini（W 19.7 × D 7.6 × H 16.5 cm，HK$280），有橙紅色、奶油色及藍色，全部全新。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）或電郵 hello@tacktackstudio.com 即可查詢購買；可預約自取，或全港送貨。

### Swell 同 Swell Mini 有咩分別？
主要係尺寸同用途。Swell 有三個波浪，浪尖可以掛外套、袋和帽，浪谷可以放鎖匙和太陽眼鏡；Swell Mini 只有一個波浪，半掛鈎半收納碗，適合門口掛袋或床邊放眼鏡。尺寸：Swell（W 73 × D 7.6 × H 35.6 cm，HK$980），有白色、橙紅色及藍色；Swell Mini（W 19.7 × D 7.6 × H 16.5 cm，HK$280），有橙紅色、奶油色及藍色。
